title: Wifi passwords
body:
are the autogenerated per device?
are they persistent across updates?
is it a default password for all rayhunters?
can you change the wifi passwords and SSID names?

comments.body:
i think this was answered on mattermost but just for completeness: wifi passwords and the way to change them work exactly the same way before and after installing rayhunter. rayhunter does not change how the device works and all the manufacturer's usage manuals are still relevant. 

the admin page for changing wifi settings, updating firmware etc can still be reached under port 80, and rayhunter just adds a second admin page for its own functionality on port 8080.
